order_status.reason: The study reconstructs substitutions on branches. Earlier ancestral branches precede their descendants; substitutions on the same branch are unordered. No measured mutant viability panel or obligatory permissive-before-adaptive constraints were published.

structure_scope.purpose: Use the modern scaffold for every residue location; no ancestral coordinates required. Do not treat its side-chain identities, exposure or distances as ancestral measurements.
structure_scope.numbering: Paper mature position n = PDB author n; UniProt = n+offset loaded from numbering_offsets.json.

missing_for_validation: Full source-reconstructed ancestral endpoint sequences, node IDs, per-site posterior probabilities and codon-aligned versions in the model input; extant TOGA2 rows alone do not identify these original reconstructed branches.
The published reconstructed sequences are amino acids. Historical codons and synonymous order are not supplied: any synthetic codon encoding is a declared modeling choice, not source truth.

No experimental within-branch order or site-pair epistasis labels exist in this paper. Geometry/charge enrichment can be evaluated, but cannot establish recovery of experimentally measured epistasis or mutation order.
Specify branch and endpoints, surface/exposure threshold and pH before scoring. Original ZMb uses site-specific pKa at pH6.5 (TableS2), not a simple count of Lys/Arg minus Asp/Glu.
A comparator must match only published partial orders; sister-lineage events cannot be concatenated into a single trajectory.
corrections_to_existing: Mirceta reports typical ZMb at pH6.5 rising from about+1 to about+5, not+7.
Modern1MBO is accepted as scaffold per user instruction; absence of ancestral coordinates is not a blocker for residue localization.
FigS2 supplies many explicit substitution identities and branch assignments; existing MB1/MB2 registry did not enumerate them.
Surface charge and aggregation association does not provide individually assayed epistatic pairs.
interpretation_notes: Preserve study source labels including G1V/V1G; N-terminal substitutions can alter the site-specific terminal ionization treatment.
S132R versus S132K, Q152H versus other labels, and repeated N12H events are distinct lineage-specific events. Identical labels in sister lineages are not the same event.
Some unlabelled stem branches have different modeled charge states; do not infer unreported substitutions from those net charge differences.
Structural helix assignments come from modern1MBO _struct_conf, not inferred ancestral secondary structure.
